name: Susmindar Jeet Kaur

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Susmindar Jeet Kaur is a Ludhiana-based poet, editor, translator and English academic. Her poetry collections include Voices From Within and The Tapestry of Heartstrings. She edited the anthology Contemporary Global Fiction, published by Penprints, bringing together stories by writers from different cultural backgrounds.

“From Dusk to Dawn” follows a woman reclaiming a self long defined by inherited stories and expectations. Figures from Indian mythology meet echoes of English literature as the poem questions the language of patience, virtue and sacrifice. Images of fire, ashes, manuscripts and seeds carry its movement from erasure towards renewal.
